ideas.text: An AI that writes your self-review in the third person so you feel less like a con artist.
A tool that detects 'meets expectations' and automatically schedules a sad walk.
An app that converts 'needs improvement' into a specific list of improvements instead of leaving you to guess.
A bot that reminds you to document your wins every week so your self-review isn't written in a panic in November.
An AI that predicts your performance rating based on how often your manager cancels your 1:1s.
A peer review generator that produces feedback so vague it is technically honest and absolutely useless.
An app that translates 'this was a challenging year for the team' into 'you will not be getting a raise.'
A tool that detects when a review is just last year's review with the year changed.
An AI that fills out your development goals using whatever aspirational thing you told LinkedIn last year.
A bot that detects when 'you're almost ready' has been said three reviews in a row and files a complaint.
An app that reverse-engineers what 'demonstrates strategic judgment' actually means at your specific company.
A calibration session simulator that lets you practice arguing for yourself in a room full of people arguing for themselves.
An AI that generates growth feedback for people who have literally not grown but you need to say something.
A tool that detects when someone's 360 feedback is clearly from one passive-aggressive person writing on six accounts.
An app that scores your review meeting based on how many times your manager broke eye contact when asked about promotion.
A bot that writes your peer feedback in 90 seconds so you stop procrastinating for the last 3 days of the cycle.
An AI that identifies which of your accomplishments sounds impressive to a manager versus which ones actually were impressive.
A tool that tracks how many development goals from last year you actually did versus said you'd do.
An app that converts your manager's vague feedback into three specific behavioral changes you could make by Tuesday.
A bot that detects when 'you just need more executive presence' is being used to avoid saying something specific.
An AI that rewrites your accomplishments from 'I did a thing' to 'I drove measurable impact at organizational scale.'
A tool that reminds you of every project you completed in Q1 that you have already forgotten by Q4.
An app that detects when your manager is giving you their own unresolved feedback instead of yours.
A bot that auto-submits your self-review at 11:58pm the night before the deadline.
An AI that scans all peer reviews for sycophancy and returns a signal-to-noise ratio.
A tool that predicts your rating from the energy in your manager's calendar the week before calibration.
An app that detects when an 'exceeds expectations' rating is being given because your manager is afraid of you.
A bot that blocks access to your review form until you can answer 'what did you actually accomplish this quarter.'
An AI that generates the promotion business case your manager promised to write and hasn't started.
A tool that detects when 'the timing wasn't right' is code for 'we gave your budget to someone else.'
An app that adds a confidence interval to every metric you cite in your self-review.
A bot that reads your review out loud in the voice of your inner critic so you can hear how unfair it sounds.
An AI that maps the gap between what you were hired to do and what you were reviewed on.
A tool that detects when a PIP was written by someone who has already made the decision and is documenting backwards.
An app that translates 'we value your contributions' followed by a 0% raise into plain English.
A bot that calculates how many years you've been 'almost ready' and graphs the trajectory.
An AI that identifies which of your colleagues got promoted by doing less work with more visibility.
A tool that converts your review into a LinkedIn post so you can share the pain publicly.
An app that detects when your manager wrote your review while clearly multitasking.
A bot that assigns a dollar value to every vague piece of feedback you received and invoices the company for your time.
An AI that predicts whether your manager has read your self-review based on the specificity of their follow-up questions.
A tool that flags when you've spent more time formatting your review than writing it.
An app that detects when 'areas for growth' is just a list of things the reviewer personally doesn't do either.
A bot that generates a motivational pep talk after 'solid contributor' for the fourth year in a row.
An AI that writes peer feedback for people you barely interact with using only their Slack activity.
A tool that tracks the company's use of the word 'calibration' and estimates how calibrated anything actually is.
An app that detects review season and automatically cancels all ambitious personal projects for November and December.
A bot that generates a Glassdoor review draft based on your performance review rating and tone.
An AI that flags when your review form has not changed since 2017 and the rubric no longer describes real work.
A tool that schedules a 10-minute cry break into your calendar the day reviews are released, just in case.
An app that automatically promotes you after 3 consecutive years of 'exceeds expectations' without a title change.
A bot that detects when 'let's revisit this in 6 months' is the third time that sentence has been used.
An AI that rewrites review feedback in the style of a Yelp review so it's easier to emotionally process.
A tool that identifies the single most useless piece of feedback you received this cycle and files it in the trash.
An app that detects when your calibration meeting is running over and automatically approves everyone as 'fine.'
A bot that sends your peer reviewers a gentle nudge every day until they submit, formatted as an invoice for your time.
